label: Reason for action
resolution: Conditional plan guidance here means preservation of ideal acceptance from an accepted factual atom together with an accepted factual-to-forbidden conditional. It is not a categorical normative reason, attitude-independent warrant, motivational force, or empirical capacity to persuade. FactualFreedom only states that satisfiable syntactically factual theories leave an all-permitting point; it does not entail that noncognitivists lack all reasons, that cognitivists require this semantics, or that factual and normative vocabulary cannot coincide under a defended naturalistic analysis.
note: The provisional Carneades caption objection at 03:54–04:49 motivates asking which sense is intended. No source claim attributes this distinction or a specific formal semantics to the channel. The strongest expressivist reply may supply structured practical commitments; the strongest cognitivist reply may demand categorical warrant and semantic/psychological explanation. Both obligations remain open.
